name: Tide Progress
description: A vessel that fills with water to show progress, with a surface that sloshes when the value changes and a percentage that changes colour where the water covers it.

props.name: value
props.description: How far it has got. The level follows with a spring and the surface sloshes.

props.name: shape
props.description: The vessel: a round flask, an upright capsule, or a wide tank three times as long as it is tall.

props.name: size
props.description: Height of the vessel in pixels. The width follows from the shape.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the value in the middle. It is drawn in ink above the water and in the water's foreground below it, split along the surface.

props.name: isIndeterminate
props.description: There is no known end: the level rocks slowly around the middle and the value is hidden.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the water. With a custom colour, set `--miyuki-tide-progress-under` to the text colour that reads on it.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label under the vessel, which also names the progress bar. Without it, pass aria-label.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components ProgressBar.
